algebra_and_alias_review: Clenshaw derivative recurrence differentiates the represented degree12 polynomial exactly in real arithmetic. Coefficients arise from a square 13-node interpolation solve: no degree truncation, but coefficient generation and evaluation are rounded and must be identified in checkpoints.
Full RC endpoint transport still calls the direct13 cardinal weights; it does not incorrectly substitute V*P weights. V remains the fixed original observation projection.

append reads phi while writing qr scratch only; history insertion destructively consumes phi second. Neither operation needs phi after insertion. Cost/fit/stream must remain serialized. No newly introduced scratch lifetime collision found.

Binary64 subtraction via sign flip and addition preserves finite-input subtraction under the same addition runtime. Linked disassembly contains the 16-byte wrapper calling __aeabi_dadd and no separate __aeabi_dsub/__subdf3 symbol; NaN payload preservation is not claimed.

findings.finding: A multirow advance may insert a prefix into history and mutate RC response before a later invalid row. The exception leaves field count and H/path state uncommitted. valid=0 refuses direct queries, but initialize can re-enable this inconsistent partial state. This is permitted only under the documented caller-quarantine contract, not safe recovery by refitting.
findings.evidence: Independent valid-row/invalid-temperature-row test observes history mutation, unchanged count, query refusal, then successful initialize.
findings.required_disposition: Campaign must irreversibly quarantine or discard the entire object after any native advance exception; alternatively enforce a sticky failure state at the adapter boundary. Test failed continuation and restore behavior. Do not treat initialize as recovery.

findings.finding: Summing six named section sizes can miss alignment gaps and allocated orphan sections. size005 currently has no such gap: _end 0x10006538 minus SRAM origin 0x10000000 equals25912B, matching its section sum. Thus no numeric undercount found for this artifact, but measurement is not general.
